species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 64°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 36–42 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
North wind at 9 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.

why: Water 64°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
